_info: Weekly calendar (Madrid time). Slot A = 06:00, B = 11:00, C = 18:00. Edit here to change what goes out each day; Make only says which slot it is.
_games: Games: stop = 'Stop the video', hl = 'Higher or Lower'. The 'cup' series (World Cup of countries) is built but NOT scheduled yet: add "cup" to a slot to start it.
